# pve_storage_iscsidirect (Data Source)

Reads an iSCSI direct-attached storage definition from `GET /storage/{storage}`. Errors when the storage's upstream type is not `iscsidirect`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_iscsidirect" "fast" {
  storage = "fast"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `storage` (String) The storage identifier to look up (PVE `pve-storage-id` format).

### Read-Only

- `content` (Set of String) Allowed content types as a set (PVE `pve-storage-content-list`). iSCSI direct storages only support `images`.
- `digest` (String) The read-only storage configuration revision (PVE `digest`).
- `disable` (Boolean) Whether the storage is disabled.
- `max_protected_backups` (Number) Maximal number of protected backups per guest (PVE `max-protected-backups`). `-1` means unlimited.
- `nodes` (String) Comma-separated list of cluster node names the storage configuration applies to (PVE `pve-node-list`).
- `nowritecache` (Boolean) Whether write caching on the target is disabled (PVE `nowritecache`).
- `portal` (String) iSCSI portal (IP or DNS name with optional port), for example `192.168.1.10:3260` (PVE `pve-storage-portal-dns`).
- `prune_backups` (String) The retention options in PVE `prune-backups` format, for example `keep-last=3,keep-daily=7`.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the storage is marked as shared with the same contents on all nodes.
- `target` (String) iSCSI target, for example `iqn.2000-01.com.example:fast.target0`.
